svg.title: Byzantine generals problem
svg.desc: Hacked node D tells node A that Alice pays Bob and tells the others that Alice pays Carol. On the left, 4 nodes need 3 matching votes: Carol gets B, C and D, Bob gets only A, so A drops Bob and every honest ledger agrees. On the right, 3 nodes need 2 votes, D votes for both, each batch gets 2, and A and B finalize different ledgers.

g.text: Carol is final, A drops Bob

svg.text: With 4 nodes the lie is outvoted 3 to 1. With 3 nodes the ledgers split.
